# ADR-046 — Phase 6 is a read-only, server-side Google Health cloud integration; trailing-window re-fetch; webhooks permanently excluded

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**Phase 6 is Google Health cloud integration, read-only, server-side.** Supersedes the `ARCHITECTURE.md` phase-plan entry for Phase 6 only: **Apple HealthKit, `@kingstinct/react-native-healthkit`, Android Health Connect and `react-native-health-connect` are removed from scope entirely** — no native health access, no device-local health sync, no Apple Developer dependency. Personal OS reads the **Google Health API** (`health.googleapis.com`, `/v4`) over OAuth 2.0 with **exactly three read-only scopes** (`activity_and_fitness.readonly`, `sleep.readonly`, `health_metrics_and_measurements.readonly`), synchronised by `apps/worker` into PostgreSQL and rendered by the existing Expo client. The legacy Fitbit Web API is **not** a target and no dual Fitbit/Google migration layer is built — there are no existing Fitbit tokens to migrate. **Webhooks are permanently excluded under ADR-018**: the documented subscriber endpoint *"must use HTTPS (TLSv1.2+) and be publicly accessible"*, and this project adds no public ingress. Because the API documents **no sync token, no `updateTime` filter, no `showDeleted` and no tombstones** — and `reconcile` is multi-source de-duplication, not change tracking — synchronisation is a **bounded trailing-window re-fetch with per-row content hashing**. This carries an explicit, accepted **35-day staleness contract**: an upstream edit or deletion older than the warm window is invisible until an explicit re-verify. Densification (writing `has_data=false` for a verified-absent day) is permitted on **warm/manual/backfill only, never `hot`**, is skipped entirely when a chunk returns zero buckets, and is clamped to dates at or after the first date that has ever returned data — so a transient empty response cannot blank real data and a backfill cannot manufacture verified-absent history for months before the device existed (Phase 6 Checkpoint 6.0, user-approved 2026-08-24)
